title: From Discharge Notes to Patient Understanding: Persona-Grounded, Open-Ended Simulation of LLMs as Discharge Educators
abstract: arXiv:2609.20827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hospital discharge education is an interactive teaching task: a clinician adapts a discharge plan to a patient's literacy, recall, and personality. Existing LLM evaluations target static or artifact-generation tasks and do not measure patient understanding under open-ended dialogue. We introduce DischargeBench, a persona-grounded simulation in which a candidate LLM educator conducts a multi-turn session with a Virtual Patient, while an Education Monitor Agent regulates patient realism without modifying the educator, protecting the evaluation signal. We curate MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench, 477 cases over 24 ICD chapters with persona axes (personality, education level, health literacy, past-medical-history recall) for stratified analysis. Each simulation is scored on four axes -- Conversation Quality, Topic Checklist, Comprehension, and Factual Consistency -- by an LLM-as-a-Judge aligned against physician annotations. translated_title: 从出院记录到患者理解：基于人设的开放式大语言模型出院教育者模拟
translated_abstract: 医院出院教育是一项互动式教学任务：临床医生需要根据患者的文化水平、记忆能力和个性特点来调整出院计划。现有的大语言模型（LLM）评估主要针对静态任务或产物生成任务，无法衡量开放式对话情境下患者的理解程度。我们提出了DischargeBench，一个基于人设的模拟基准，其中候选LLM教育者与虚拟患者进行多轮对话，同时由一个教育监控智能体在不修改教育者行为的前提下调节虚拟患者的真实性，从而保护评估信号的有效性。我们构建了MIMIC-IV-Ext-DischargeBench数据集，包含覆盖24个ICD章节的477个病例，并设置人设维度（性格、教育水平、健康素养、既往病史记忆）用于分层分析。每次模拟由一个与医生标注对齐的LLM-as-a-Judge在四个维度上进行评分——对话质量、话题清单、理解程度和事实一致性。在闭源与开源模型上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了DischargeBench，首个基于人设的开放式出院教育模拟基准，通过虚拟患者多轮对话与教育监控智能体，从对话质量、话题覆盖、理解程度和事实一致性四个维度评估大语言模型作为出院教育者促进患者理解的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DischargeBench, the first persona-grounded, open-ended simulation benchmark that evaluates LLMs as discharge educators through multi-turn dialogue with virtual patients, scoring them on conversation quality, topic coverage, comprehension, and factual consistency aligned with physician annotations.
